claim: Fresh derived-timing seed 990018 qualified the repaired rival and ordinary-wild boundaries, then stopped at the Viridian entrance because movement resumed before the battle-to-overworld handoff was stable. The run stopped before any learned battle or training decision. This is a preserved input-handoff defect, not a model-prediction failure.

failure.message: The clean run missed the stable Viridian City entrance gate.

direct_reproduction.causal_trial: Adding only a 120-frame post-flee stabilization wait reached the exact Viridian City entrance gate at map 1, coordinate 21,35. The same trial then advanced beyond Oak's errand and exposed another ordinary Route 1 encounter in the Pewter chapter.

diagnosis.finding: The first battle-state-zero and input-readiness observation precedes the stable overworld input boundary. Immediate route actions can therefore be accepted by the executor but ignored by the game, producing silent coordinate drift.
diagnosis.secondary_finding: The post-Pokedex Pewter chapter used a separate zero-wild Route 1 traversal, so incidental-wild support had not yet been applied consistently across both early-game crossings.
diagnosis.model_boundary: No learned battle, switch-target, training-control, or trainee/venue decision had occurred. The scheduled trainer-battle perturbation controller had consumed zero of 74 entries.

repair.behavior: A shared Route 1 wild-escape primitive now waits a declared positive stabilization interval after the first ready battle exit, rereads the cartridge, and requires the same coordinate, living party, exact party/level/max-HP/PP/status preservation, result two, and released controls before route movement resumes.
repair.chapter_coverage: Both Oak's errand crossings and the post-Pokedex Pewter crossing use the same bounded helper. Each chapter retains an eight-encounter ceiling and rejects trainer battles, wrong maps, failed preservation, invalid menu state, or a seventeenth RUN attempt.
repair.public_receipt: Each flee receipt now includes the stabilization interval in addition to opponent, coordinate, HP, RUN attempts, control readiness, and protected-state checks. Pewter's chapter report carries its own Route 1 flee receipts.
repair.next_gate: Commit and push the source-bound repair that passed 2165 ROM-free tests plus Ruff, mypy, public-artifact, documentation, and registry checks, then run a fresh uncounted derived-timing root. Counted v95 remains unopened.
